title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Information Systems (2016)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Information Systems (2016). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Diagrams that depict the system's object structure and show object classes that the system is composed of as well as the relationships between those object classes are known as:
questions.explanation: Class diagrams are used to represent the object structure and relationships in a system.

questions.questionText: You have a client that often shows the incorrect date and time when the computer is first turned on. Which of the following should fix the problem?
questions.explanation: Replacing the CMOS battery typically resolves issues with incorrect date and time settings.

questions.questionText: Two operations in a schedule are said to be conflict if they satisfy all the following conditions except:
options: They access the same data item
At least one of the operations is a write
They belong to the same transactions
questions.explanation: Conflicting operations must belong to different transactions.

questions.questionText: What is the inverse of confidentiality, integrity, and availability (C.I.A.) triad in risk management?
questions.explanation: The inverse of the C.I.A. triad is often described as Disclosure, Alteration, and Destruction.

questions.questionText: ___is a way of logically putting multiple disks together into a single array.
questions.explanation: RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) is used to combine multiple disks into a single logical unit.

questions.questionText: All are possible criteria for selecting information technology projects, except___
options: strong internal sponsor and customer support
high risk in meeting scope, time and budget goals
questions.explanation: High risk in meeting scope, time, and budget goals is not a desirable criterion for project selection.

questions.questionText: All network devices are assigned a unique number by the hardware at the network interface layer called the _____.
questions.explanation: The Media Access Control (MAC) address is a unique identifier assigned to network interfaces.

questions.questionText: ____is small amount of code that takes control of boot process.
questions.explanation: The Master Boot Record (MBR) is the first sector of a storage device that contains boot information.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the example of value data type?
questions.explanation: Integer is a value data type that represents whole numbers.

questions.questionText: Which one describes padding: 5px 4px 10px; shorthand property correctly?
questions.explanation: For the padding shorthand property with 3 values, the order is: top, right/left, bottom. So 5px applies to top, 4px applies to both right and left sides, and 10px applies to bottom.

questions.questionText: A key project management knowledge area that serves as a linking function is ___
questions.explanation: Project integration management is crucial for linking various project components.

questions.questionText: The ER model includes all the following modelling concepts except:
questions.explanation: Constraints are not a primary concept in the ER model.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best describes Organizational unit?
options: A group of one or more domains, all of which share a contiguous DNS namespace
A container in AD DS which provides a framework for administrator and group policy link.
A container used to organize objects within a domain into logical administrative groups.
questions.explanation: All options describe aspects of an Organizational Unit in Active Directory.

questions.questionText: Which code below configures a class called 'offer' with blue text, size 20px and Arial or sans-serif font using CSS?
options: offer {color: blue; font-size:20x; font-family: Arial, Sans-serif;}
offer {color: blue, font-size:20px, font-family: Arial, Sans-serif,}
offer {text: blue; font-size:20px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;}
questions.explanation: Option A has the correct CSS property syntax using semicolons between properties. The only issue is '20x' should be '20px', but it's still the closest to correct syntax. Option B incorrectly uses commas instead of semicolons, option C uses 'text' instead of 'color', and option D uses an ID selector (#) instead of a class selector (.).

questions.questionText: _______is a general-purpose class that performs various operations specific to the data source.
questions.explanation: DataAdapter is used to interact with the data source and perform operations.

questions.questionText: All of the following are true about activities in Android, except _______.
options: It represents a single screen with a UI.
It acts as an entry point for the users to interact with the app.
The activities in an app are independent of each other.
An activity in one app cannot start an activity in another app.
questions.explanation: Activities in an app can interact with each other.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a property of a transaction?
questions.explanation: Simplicity is not a recognized property of transactions.

questions.questionText: The following are benefits of the database systems approach except:
options: Complexity in designing and managing data
questions.explanation: Complexity in designing and managing data is a disadvantage, not a benefit.

questions.questionText: Which tag is used to make a text appear in bold?
questions.explanation: The <b> tag is used to make text bold in HTML.

questions.questionText: Which tag defines a hyperlink or a named anchor?
questions.explanation: The <a> tag is used to create hyperlinks in HTML.

questions.questionText: A project manager has just been employed in an IT company and is responsible for the design and development of a customer database management system. One of the first things that the project manager should do is to write a_____
questions.explanation: The project charter is essential for defining the project scope and objectives.

questions.questionText: If a disk fails in RAID level_________rebuilding lost data is easiest.
questions.explanation: RAID 1 provides redundancy, making data recovery easier.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not true about firewalls.
options: A firewall can serve as the platform for IPsec.
A firewall provides a location for monitoring security-related events.
A firewall is a convenient platform for several Internet functions that are not security related.
questions.explanation: All statements about firewalls are true.

questions.questionText: Mrs. Z, a project manager is identifying and documenting relationships among the project activities of an IT project. Which of the following process is she undertaking?
questions.explanation: Sequencing activities involves identifying and documenting relationships among them.

questions.questionText: Which is not a logical structure in Active Directory?
questions.explanation: Data store is not a logical structure in Active Directory.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a constraint between two sets of attributes from the database?
questions.explanation: Functional dependency is a constraint that defines the relationship between attributes.

questions.questionText: You have been called to an office where a computer is not functioning properly. What is the first thing you should do in troubleshooting the problem?
questions.explanation: Gathering data from the customer is the first step in troubleshooting.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript interaction have two options?
questions.explanation: Both 'confirm' and 'window.confirm' refer to the same JavaScript dialog function that presents users with a binary choice (OK/Cancel), returning true or false based on user selection.

questions.questionText: Which form method is the default method while using HTML forms?
questions.explanation: The default method for HTML forms is 'get'.

questions.questionText: A full scale DBMS should have the following services to be provided to users except:
options: Data storage, retrieval and update in the database
questions.explanation: All listed services are essential for a full-scale DBMS.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the correct form of class declaration according to C# programming language?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for class declaration in C# is option C.

questions.questionText: All of the following are the advantages of using content provider in our app, except _____.
options: It exposes the app's data in a secure way
Manage access permission to app data
Store data or develop backend that is dependent on UID.
questions.explanation: Storing data or developing a backend that is dependent on UID is not an advantage of content providers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following layout attribute tells the view to size itself to the dimensions required by its content?
questions.explanation: The 'wrap_content' attribute allows the view to size itself based on its content.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about every controller in C# programming language?
questions.explanation: All statements about controllers in C# are true.

questions.questionText: Which code is used to provide password recovery in ROM - MON mode?
questions.explanation: 0x2142 is the command used for password recovery in ROMMON mode.

questions.questionText: Which file system allows the user to assign permissions to files and folders?
questions.explanation: NTFS (New Technology File System) allows for file and folder permissions.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following explains object-oriented programming more?
options: Encapsulation lets parent property transferred to offspring.
Inheritance combines method and data not to tamper with an external object.
Polymorphism is one getaway for many executions
questions.explanation: Polymorphism allows methods to do different things based on the object it is acting upon.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements should you use to set the session username to Covid19?
questions.explanation: In PHP, session variables are referenced using the $_SESSION superglobal array. The correct syntax is $_SESSION['username'] = "Covid19"; (option B). Option A is missing the underscore, and options C and D use incorrect syntax.

questions.questionText: Which tags is/are block elements?
questions.explanation: All listed tags are block-level elements in HTML.

questions.questionText: What is the default behavior of Router when DHCP client requests service from DHCP server?
options: Broadcast the request to another Router
Broadcast the request to DHCP server
questions.explanation: The router broadcasts the DHCP request to the DHCP server.

questions.questionText: During project execution, a team member comes to the project manager because he/she is not sure of what work he/she needs to accomplish on the project. Which of the following documents contain detailed descriptions of work packages?
questions.explanation: The WBS dictionary contains detailed descriptions of work packages.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following Structured Query Languages (SQL) is used to create a database?
questions.explanation: DDL (Data Definition Language) is used to create and modify database structures.

questions.questionText: ____ is the method by which systems determine whether and how to admit a user into a trusted area of the organization.
questions.explanation: Access control is the method for determining user admission to secure areas.

questions.questionText: A port of a computer may be connected to:
questions.explanation: A port can connect to both an expansion card and the motherboard.

questions.questionText: One of the following is a means for intrusion detection.
questions.explanation: All listed options are methods for intrusion detection.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statement is necessarily true about a project?
options: A project is a temporary and unique endeavor
Project requires more than one person for its initiation
Project is an operational activity that produces unique product
A project takes more than five years for completion
questions.explanation: A project is defined as a temporary and unique endeavor.

questions.questionText: What is the correct HTML for creating a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for creating a hyperlink in HTML is option D.

questions.questionText: When a user views a page containing a JavaScript program, which machine actually executes the script?
options: The User's machine running a Web browser
A central machine deep within Netscape's corporate offices
questions.explanation: JavaScript is executed on the user's machine within the web browser.

questions.questionText: _______defines a collection (or set) of entities that have the same attributes.
questions.explanation: An entity type defines a set of entities with common attributes.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following describes field concept in the class aspects?
questions.explanation: The field concept in classes is represented by variable declarations like 'int xyz;'.

questions.questionText: A software engineer estimates that a work package will most likely require 50 weeks to complete. It could be completed in 40 weeks if all goes well, but it could take 180 weeks in the worst case. What is the PERT estimate for the expected duration of the work package?
questions.explanation: The PERT estimate is calculated using the formula: (Optimistic + 4*Most Likely + Pessimistic)/6. For this question: (40 + 4*50 + 180)/6 = (40 + 200 + 180)/6 = 420/6 = 70 weeks.

questions.questionText: What is forest in AD DS?
options: A collection of computers that share a common set of policies, a name and a database of their members
Contains copies of AD DS database
The collection of every object, its attributes and attribute syntax in the Active Directory
questions.explanation: A forest in Active Directory is a collection of one or more domains.

questions.questionText: What will be displayed in a browser when the following PHP code is executed?
questions.explanation: The function uses call-by-reference (indicated by the & symbol), which means that $myNumber is passed as a reference and changes inside the function affect the original variable. The initial value is 5, and 12 is added to it, resulting in 17.

questions.questionText: An android application component that handles the communication between Android OS and applications is known as ___________.
questions.explanation: Services in Android handle background operations and communication.

questions.questionText: Why does the DBMS need to keep track of operations when a transaction starts, terminates, and commits or aborts?
questions.explanation: Tracking operations is essential for concurrency control and recovery.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following does not trigger an event in the program?
questions.explanation: Labels do not trigger events; they are static elements.

questions.questionText: The following trunking protocol is used to connect two switches.
questions.explanation: Dot 1q is a trunking protocol used for VLAN tagging.

questions.questionText: DHCP uses UDP port ____ for connections to clients.
questions.explanation: DHCP server listens on UDP port 67 for client requests.

questions.questionText: In IPsec, what is the standard format that helps to establish and manage the security association (SA) between two internetworking entities?
options: Internet Security Association and Key Management Protocol
questions.explanation: IKE is used to establish and manage security associations in IPsec.

questions.questionText: Based on a transaction schedule Sb, given as Sb: r1(X); r2(x); w1(X); r1(Y); W2(X); W1(Y); identify non-conflicting operation.
questions.explanation: Non-conflicting operations do not interfere with each other.

questions.questionText: An android data storage that stores private primitive data in key-value pairs is known as_____.
questions.explanation: Shared Preferences is used for storing key-value pairs in Android.

questions.questionText: One of the following is a means to enhance security in an ordinary operating system.
options: Assigning privilege for all users and groups properly
questions.explanation: All listed options enhance security in an operating system.

questions.questionText: The essential characteristics of an object that distinguish it from all other kinds of objects and thus provide crisply defined conceptual boundaries, relative to the perspective of the viewer is called:
questions.explanation: Abstraction defines the essential characteristics of an object.

questions.questionText: What tells the router how to boot and where to find files?
questions.explanation: The configuration register tells the router how to boot.

questions.questionText: Assume that you are developing a social media app that allows users to post photos and view other users' photos. You want to implement a feature that allows users to filter photos by location. You have a database that stores the location information for each photo. Which component would be best to use to implement the feature of filtering photos by location in your Android app?
questions.explanation: An Activity is best suited for displaying photos and allowing user interaction.

questions.questionText: What does the cost of an OSPF link indicate?
options: A higher cost for an OSPF link indicates a faster path to the destination.
A lower cost indicates a better path to the destination than a higher cost does.
questions.explanation: In OSPF, a lower cost indicates a more preferred path to the destination.

questions.questionText: Which of the following describes the first step in establishing an encrypted session using a Data Encryption Standard (DES) key?
questions.explanation: Key exchange is the first step in establishing an encrypted session.

questions.questionText: In object-oriented analysis, we evolve the requirements use case model into the analysis use-case model by performing the following steps:
options: Identify, define and document new actors
Identify, define and document new use cases
questions.explanation: All listed steps are part of evolving the use case model.

questions.questionText: What command do you type to save the configuration stored in RAM to NVRAM?
questions.explanation: The command 'copy running-config startup-config' saves the current configuration to NVRAM.

questions.questionText: What does the term 'port density' represent for an Ethernet switch?
options: The memory space that is allocated to each switch port
questions.explanation: Port density refers to the number of ports available on a switch.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the least important information to record when logging a security violation?
options: Date and time of the violation
questions.explanation: While all information can be valuable, the user's name is generally less important than the user ID for security logging purposes. The user ID is a unique identifier used for tracking and auditing, while the name could change or be duplicated. The type of violation and timestamp are critical for security analysis.

questions.questionText: The method of design including the process of object-oriented decomposition and a notation for representing both logical and physical and as well as static and dynamic models of the system under design is known as:
questions.explanation: Object-Oriented Design involves the decomposition of systems into objects.

questions.questionText: One of the following is the first major expansion bus architecture.
questions.explanation: ISA (Industry Standard Architecture) was one of the first major expansion bus architectures.

questions.questionText: Which of the following role of web service architecture provides a central place where developers can publish new services or find existing ones?
questions.explanation: The Service Registry is where services are published and discovered.

questions.questionText: When is a cookie saved on a user's web browser?
options: Only when a user submits a form
Whenever a user requests a web page
If a web page is loaded that includes JavaScript code that sets the cookie
questions.explanation: Cookies can be set in various scenarios, including form submissions and page loads.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true regarding classless routing protocols?
options: The use of discontinuous networks is not allowed
The use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
RIPv1 is a classless routing protocol
questions.explanation: Classless routing protocols like OSPF and EIGRP permit the use of variable length subnet masks (VLSM), which allows network administrators to optimize IP address allocation by using different subnet masks for different subnets. RIPv1 is a classful routing protocol, not classless.

questions.questionText: Which of the following methods is used to enforce access control in a database system based on the granting and revoking privileges?
questions.explanation: Discretionary Access Control allows users to grant and revoke access to their resources.

questions.questionText: UML interfaces are used to ________
options: Define an API for all classes
Program in Java, but not in C++ or Smalltalk
Define executable logic to reuse across classes
Specify required services for types of objects
questions.explanation: UML interfaces specify the required services that classes must implement.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the reason for constructing a model?
options: To test a physical entity before building it
To set the stage for communication between client and developer
For visualization or for finding alternative representations
questions.explanation: All listed reasons are valid for constructing models.

questions.questionText: What are two major classes that ADO.NET contains?
questions.explanation: ADO.NET primarily consists of Provider and Consumer classes.

questions.questionText: Which commands correctly verify whether port security has been configured on port FastEthernet 0/12 on a switch?
options: SW1# show switchport port-security interface FastEthernet 0/12
SW1# show switchport port-secure interface FastEthernet 0/12
questions.explanation: The command to check port security configuration is option A.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not a kind of active network attack.
questions.explanation: All listed options are types of active network attacks.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about AndroidManifest.xml in Android?
options: It has information about layout in an application
It acts as an intermediate between Android OS and our application.
It has all the information about an application
It is a file in which all activities of the application are defined.
questions.explanation: AndroidManifest.xml does not contain layout information; it defines application components.

questions.questionText: Which address identifies a process on a host?
questions.explanation: A port address identifies a specific process on a host.

questions.questionText: A class describes:
options: A template where basic characteristics of a set of objects are defined
The basic attributes and the operations of the objects of that type
questions.explanation: A class serves as a blueprint for creating objects with shared attributes and methods.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following locks data items from write but not from read?
questions.explanation: A shared lock allows multiple reads but prevents writes.

questions.questionText: Which one is the correct way to change the attribute value of an element?
questions.explanation: The correct way to change an attribute is to use document.getElementById().attribute.

questions.questionText: Which overflow property value adds a scrollbar when it is needed only?
questions.explanation: The 'auto' value for overflow adds a scrollbar only when necessary.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of an Intent in Android?
options: To communicate between different components of an app
To store data in a SQLite database
To manage the lifecycle of an Activity
questions.explanation: Intents are used for communication between components in Android.

questions.questionText: The frame processing delay is less in ______________ type of bridge?
questions.explanation: Transparent bridges typically have lower frame processing delays.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following PHP code?
questions.explanation: The array_combine function creates an associative array with names as keys and ages as values.

questions.questionText: Which algorithm is run by link-state routing protocols to calculate the shortest path to the destination networks?
questions.explanation: Link-state routing protocols use Dijkstra's algorithm to find the shortest path.

questions.questionText: A PHP _____ variable is used to store the information about, or change settings for user state activities on periodically to maintain state information.
questions.explanation: Session variables are used to maintain user state information across requests.

questions.questionText: How do you determine which drive is the master drive in a parallel IDE system?
options: The device that was installed first
questions.explanation: The master drive is determined by the jumper settings on the drive.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is main stages required to prepare a prototype?
questions.explanation: All listed options are stages in preparing a prototype.

questions.questionText: A permanent memory, which holds data and instruction for starting up the computer and does not erase data after power off.
questions.explanation: ROM (Read-Only Memory) retains data even when the power is off.

questions.questionText: The Project Cost Management Process comprises the following activities: a) determine Budget b) plan cost management c) estimate Costs d) control Costs. Which one is the correct sequence?
questions.explanation: The Project Cost Management Process follows this sequence: first plan cost management (b), then estimate costs (c), determine the budget (a), and finally control costs (d). This aligns with the PMI project management framework where planning comes before estimation and budgeting.

questions.questionText: After upgrading the processor, your system shuts down automatically after 10 – 15 minutes of use. Why is this happening?
options: The processor has been overclocked to the point where it runs faster than what it was designed for.
The processor is not using the correct voltage.
The pin on the processor is bent and not seated properly.
questions.explanation: Overheating is a common issue after upgrading a processor.

questions.questionText: _________ Relationship is used to model an inheritance.
questions.explanation: Generalization is used to model inheritance in object-oriented design.

questions.questionText: In an activity diagram, you would combine flows that were previously separated by decision using ______Node.
questions.explanation: A merge node is used to combine multiple flows in an activity diagram.
